verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a developer App SDK for building custom apps that a workspace can install. There is no mention of an app marketplace or of prebuilt Slack, support-desk, marketing or data-warehouse integrations. SDK building blocks and installing a self-built app do not count as installing prebuilt integrations from a marketplace.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can install prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) from an app marketplace
